name: path_traversal_relative
description: Path traversal with ../../etc/passwd — must be blocked by deny_path_patterns or path validation

name: empty_string_path
description: Empty string as file path

name: nonexistent_file
description: Read a file that does not exist

name: nonexistent_directory_stat
description: FileInfo on a directory that does not exist — must fail with not_found (ListDir removed in v0.3)

name: write_file_empty_content
description: Write a file with empty string content — should succeed

name: run_command_empty_args
description: RunCommand with an empty args array — should work fine

name: run_command_timeout_zero
description: RunCommand with short timeout_secs=1 — should still complete quickly

name: read_file_with_offset
description: Read file skipping first N bytes

name: checksum_nonexistent
description: Checksum on a file that doesn't exist

name: port_check_refuses_loopback
description: PortCheck classifies its target like any outbound request; loopback needs X0NE_ALLOW_LOOPBACK (set by the sandbox config). Unguarded it was an internal port scanner.

name: search_code_no_matches
description: Search for a pattern that doesn't exist anywhere

name: find_files_no_matches
description: SearchCode with a file glob that matches nothing (FindFiles removed in v0.3)

name: policy_check_meta
description: PolicyCheck action on a known-denied action — meta action should succeed even if inner would be denied

name: snapshot_list_empty
description: List snapshots when none exist — should return empty list

name: diff_files_nonexistent_source
description: Two-path read where the source side doesn't exist — must fail with not_found, not policy_denied (CopyFile removed in v0.3)

name: edit_nonexistent_source
description: Mutating a file that doesn't exist inside an allowed write root — must fail with not_found, not policy_denied (MoveFile removed in v0.3)

name: random_bytes_zero
description: Generate 0 random bytes — should return empty string

name: read_json_nonexistent
description: ReadFile on a JSON file that doesn't exist — should fail with not_found (ReadJson removed in v0.3)

name: create_temp_file_empty
description: Create an empty temp file via WriteFile with no content — should succeed with 0 bytes (CreateTempFile removed in v0.3)

name: disk_usage_test_dir
description: Disk usage for the test directory via python3 shutil.disk_usage (DiskUsage removed in v0.3)

args: import shutil; u = shutil.disk_usage('{{TEST_DIR}}'); print(u.total, u.used, u.free)
